invariants.description: charge conservation across modules: the charge on the membrane changes by exactly the cation charge that crossed it, Cm dV = F Vol d(Na_i + K_i + 2 Ca_total + H_total - lactate + ATP): protons from ATP hydrolysis and those leaving with lactate carry no membrane charge (relative 1e-6)
invariants.expr: abs(mod_membrane__Cm[0]*1e-12*(mod_membrane__V[-1] - mod_membrane__V[0])*1e-3 - 96485*mod_membrane__Vol[0]*((mod_Na_K__Nai[-1] - mod_Na_K__Nai[0]) + (mod_Na_K__Ki[-1] - mod_Na_K__Ki[0]) + 2*((mod_Ca__Cai + mod_Ca__CaB_Cai)[-1] - (mod_Ca__Cai + mod_Ca__CaB_Cai)[0]) + (mod_H__H_total_rel[-1] - mod_H__H_total_rel[0]) - (mod_cytosol__C_lac[-1] - mod_cytosol__C_lac[0]) + (mod_cytosol__C_ATP[-1] - mod_cytosol__C_ATP[0]))) <= 1e-6*96485*mod_membrane__Vol[0]*(abs((mod_Na_K__Nai[-1] - mod_Na_K__Nai[0])) + abs((mod_Na_K__Ki[-1] - mod_Na_K__Ki[0])) + abs((mod_H__H_total_rel[-1] - mod_H__H_total_rel[0]))) + 1e-21

invariants.description: adenine and phosphoryl groups are conserved through every ATP user and the PTS: ATP + ADP and ATP + Pi + G6P constant (relative 1e-9)
invariants.expr: np.ptp(mod_cytosol__C_ATP + mod_cytosol__C_ADP) <= 1e-9*np.max(mod_cytosol__C_ATP + mod_cytosol__C_ADP) and np.ptp(mod_cytosol__C_ATP + mod_cytosol__C_Pi + mod_cytosol__C_G6P) <= 1e-9*np.max(mod_cytosol__C_ATP + mod_cytosol__C_Pi + mod_cytosol__C_G6P)

invariants.description: the ATP budget closes: the cytosol's external ATP use equals what the H+-ATPase (if present), protein synthesis and biosynthesis take (relative 1e-9)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(mod_cytosol__J_ATP_turnover - mod_cytosol__J_ATP_maint, mod_i_H_ATPase__v_ATP_H + mod_protein__J_ATP_total + mod_bio__J_ATP_bio + mod_glc_PTS__J_ATP_cost + mod_glc_ABC__J_ATP_cost, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: second law for the leaks: each runs down its electrochemical gradient, i (V - E) >= 0
invariants.expr: np.all(mod_i_leak_Na__i_leak_Na*(mod_membrane__V - mod_Na_K__E_Na) >= 0) and np.all(mod_i_leak_Ca__i_leak_Ca*(mod_membrane__V - mod_i_leak_Ca__E_Ca) >= 0) and np.all(mod_i_leak_H__i_leak_H*(mod_membrane__V - mod_H__E_H) >= 0) and np.all(mod_i_K_Trk__i_leak_K*(mod_membrane__V - mod_Na_K__E_K) >= 0)

invariants.description: concentrations stay non-negative: ATP, ADP, Pi, glucose, G6P, lactate and glycogen >= -1e-9 mM
invariants.expr: np.all(mod_cytosol__C_glc >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod_cytosol__C_lac >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod_cytosol__C_ATP >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod_cytosol__C_ADP >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod_cytosol__C_Pi >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod_cytosol__C_G6P >= -1e-9) and np.all(mod_cytosol__C_glyc >= -1e-9)

invariants.description: second law for the reactions: dissipation P_diss >= 0
protein synthesis never spends more than its capacity: J_build_total <= J_cap (relative 1e-9)
second law for the H+-ATPase: it hydrolyses ATP only while the ATP affinity exceeds the proton work, v (A_hyd - n_H F (E_H - V)) >= 0
second law for the flagellar motor: H+ run down the proton motive force, j pmf >= 0
second law for the exchangers: NhaA and KefC run down their free energy, r drive >= 0
carbon is conserved through every glucose carrier: Vol d(6 glc + 6 G6P + 3 lac + 6 glycogen) = int (6 sum J_glc + 3 J_lac) dt (relative 1e-5: trapezoid integration of the logged fluxes)
invariants.expr: abs(mod_membrane__Vol[0]*(6*(mod_cytosol__C_glc[-1] - mod_cytosol__C_glc[0]) + 6*(mod_cytosol__C_G6P[-1] - mod_cytosol__C_G6P[0]) + 3*(mod_cytosol__C_lac[-1] - mod_cytosol__C_lac[0]) + 6*(mod_cytosol__C_glyc[-1] - mod_cytosol__C_glyc[0])) - np.trapz(6*(mod_membrane_face__J_glc + mod_glc_PTS__J_glc + mod_glc_ABC__J_glc + mod_glc_GalP__J_glc) + 3*mod_membrane_face__J_lac, t)) <= 1e-5*np.trapz(np.abs(6*(mod_membrane_face__J_glc + mod_glc_PTS__J_glc + mod_glc_ABC__J_glc + mod_glc_GalP__J_glc)) + np.abs(3*mod_membrane_face__J_lac), t) + 1e-30

invariants.description: the carriers' costs follow their stoichiometry (exact): one PEP (ATP equivalent) per glucose for the PTS, which delivers it as G6P, n_P ATP per glucose for the ABC importer, one H+ per glucose for the symporter
invariants.expr: np.allclose(mod_glc_PTS__J_ATP_cost, 1*mod_glc_PTS__J_glc, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(mod_glc_ABC__J_ATP_cost, n_P_glc_ABC*mod_glc_ABC__J_glc, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.array_equal(mod_glc_PTS__J_G6P, mod_glc_PTS__J_glc) and np.allclose(mod_glc_GalP__j_H, n_H_glc_GalP*mod_glc_GalP__J_glc, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: second law for the glucose carriers, each against the cytosol's own state: J (RT ln(C_e/C_glc) + n_P A_hyd) >= 0 (ABC), J (RT ln(K_eq_hk C_e ATP/(G6P ADP))) >= 0 (PTS), J (RT ln(C_e/C_glc) + n_H F (E_H - V)) >= 0 (symporter)
the default point is a steady state: V stays at -105 mV (1e-6 mV), pH at 7.6 (1e-9) and ATP at 9.6 mM (relative 1e-9)

bc_sweep.rationale: temperatures from 0 to 40 C (the default factors of 0.5 and 2 would put the cell at 147 K and 586 K, where Q10 = 2 changes every rate by 2^15 to 2^29 and nothing physical remains to check); R and F are physical constants, not swept; protein expression targets x0.25-4, growth 0-20x the resting turnover, repair and storage 0-1: the ranges AdaptOrDeity lets a player choose
